title: Adopt fills gaps and files categorised gate tasks (S27)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S27 (Sector 7 — Onboarding (ADR 0023)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0023 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
Outcome: existing workflows are read and only missing gate jobs are added; gate tasks are written with kind, area, stack and tier order
Files: see ADR 0023 Consequences.
Proof: `bin/krn adopt --verify <pilot>: duplicate-ci: 0`
Predicted: metric adopted-duplicate-ci == 0
After: S16, S26
